list.name: record_type
list.label: Type
list.query: Index : index, IOPV (ETF) : iopv, BDR reference price : bdr

list.name: ticker
list.label: Ticker
list.query:
SELECT DISTINCT ticker
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_bulletin_index_report/daily_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE record_type IN ($record_type)
  AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
ORDER BY 1
list.definition:
SELECT DISTINCT ticker
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_bulletin_index_report/daily_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE record_type IN ($record_type)
  AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Instruments
panels.description: Number of selected tickers with data in the range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(DISTINCT ticker) AS instruments
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_bulletin_index_report/daily_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE ticker IN ($ticker)
  AND record_type IN ($record_type)
  AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)

panels.title: Trading days
panels.description: Number of trading days with data in the range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(DISTINCT trad_dt) AS days
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_bulletin_index_report/daily_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE ticker IN ($ticker)
  AND record_type IN ($record_type)
  AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)

panels.title: Average return in range
panels.description: Mean of the selected tickers' returns from first to last close in the range.

targets.rawSql:
WITH r AS (
  SELECT
    ticker,
    arg_max(coalesce(closing_price, reference_price), trad_dt)::DOUBLE
      / nullif(arg_min(coalesce(closing_price, reference_price), trad_dt)::DOUBLE, 0) - 1 AS period_return
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_bulletin_index_report/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE ticker IN ($ticker)
    AND record_type IN ($record_type)
    AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
  GROUP BY ticker
)
SELECT avg(period_return) AS avg_return
FROM r

panels.title: Latest trading day
panels.description: Most recent trading day with data for the selected tickers in the range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT strftime(max(trad_dt), '%Y-%m-%d') AS latest
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_bulletin_index_report/daily_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE ticker IN ($ticker)
  AND record_type IN ($record_type)
  AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)

panels.title: Close
panels.description: Daily close per selected ticker (index points, BRL for IOPVs and BDR reference prices).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT trad_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time, ticker, coalesce(closing_price, reference_price)::DOUBLE AS close
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_bulletin_index_report/daily_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE ticker IN ($ticker)
  AND record_type IN ($record_type)
  AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
ORDER BY time, ticker

panels.title: Return since start of range
panels.description: Close relative to each ticker's first close in the range, to compare tickers on one scale.

targets.rawSql:
WITH daily AS (
  SELECT trad_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time, ticker, coalesce(closing_price, reference_price)::DOUBLE AS close
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_bulletin_index_report/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE ticker IN ($ticker)
    AND record_type IN ($record_type)
    AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
)
SELECT time, ticker, close / nullif(first_value(close) OVER (PARTITION BY ticker ORDER BY time), 0) - 1 AS return
FROM daily
ORDER BY time, ticker

panels.title: Daily change
panels.description: Close vs the previous trading day's close, per selected ticker.

targets.rawSql:
WITH daily AS (
  SELECT trad_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time, ticker, coalesce(closing_price, reference_price)::DOUBLE AS close
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_bulletin_index_report/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE ticker IN ($ticker)
    AND record_type IN ($record_type)
    AND trad_dt::TIMESTAMP >= $__timeFrom()::TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL 10 DAY
    AND trad_dt::TIMESTAMP <= $__timeTo()::TIMESTAMP
),
changes AS (
  SELECT time, ticker, close / nullif(lag(close) OVER (PARTITION BY ticker ORDER BY time), 0) - 1 AS change
  FROM daily
)
SELECT time, ticker, change
FROM changes
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
  AND change IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY time, ticker

panels.title: Daily range (high vs low)
panels.description: Daily high over low minus 1 per selected ticker, a simple intraday volatility measure (indexes and IOPVs).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT trad_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time, ticker, max_price::DOUBLE / nullif(min_price::DOUBLE, 0) - 1 AS range
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_bulletin_index_report/daily_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE ticker IN ($ticker)
  AND record_type IN ($record_type)
  AND max_price IS NOT NULL
  AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
ORDER BY time, ticker

panels.title: Breadth (share of rising constituents)
panels.description: Rising constituents over all constituents per selected index.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT trad_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time, ticker, rising_shares / nullif(rising_shares + falling_shares + stable_shares, 0) AS rising_share
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_bulletin_index_report/daily_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE ticker IN ($ticker)
  AND record_type = 'index'
  AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
ORDER BY time, ticker

panels.title: Opening gap
panels.description: Open vs the previous day's close per selected ticker (indexes and IOPVs).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT trad_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time, ticker, opening_price::DOUBLE / nullif(prev_closing_price::DOUBLE, 0) - 1 AS gap
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_bulletin_index_report/daily_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE ticker IN ($ticker)
  AND record_type IN ($record_type)
  AND opening_price IS NOT NULL
  AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
ORDER BY time, ticker

panels.title: Intraday move (close vs open)
panels.description: Close vs the same day's open per selected ticker (indexes and IOPVs).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT trad_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time, ticker, closing_price::DOUBLE / nullif(opening_price::DOUBLE, 0) - 1 AS move
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_bulletin_index_report/daily_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE ticker IN ($ticker)
  AND record_type IN ($record_type)
  AND opening_price IS NOT NULL
  AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
ORDER BY time, ticker

panels.title: Selected tickers (latest day in range)
panels.description: Prices, oscillation, settlement and breadth for the selected tickers on the latest day.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_bulletin_index_report/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE ticker IN ($ticker)
    AND record_type IN ($record_type)
    AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
)
SELECT
  ticker,
  record_type AS type,
  description,
  opening_price::DOUBLE AS open,
  max_price::DOUBLE AS high,
  min_price::DOUBLE AS low,
  coalesce(closing_price, reference_price)::DOUBLE AS close,
  prev_closing_price::DOUBLE AS prev_close,
  oscillation::DOUBLE AS oscillation,
  settlement_value::DOUBLE AS settlement,
  rising_shares AS rising,
  falling_shares AS falling,
  stable_shares AS stable
FROM d
WHERE trad_dt = (SELECT max(trad_dt) FROM d)
ORDER BY ticker

panels.title: Top gainers (range)
panels.description: Top 15 period returns in the selected types; ignores the ticker filter.

targets.rawSql:
WITH r AS (
  SELECT
    ticker,
    any_value(record_type) AS type,
    any_value(description) AS description,
    arg_min(coalesce(closing_price, reference_price), trad_dt)::DOUBLE AS first_close,
    arg_max(coalesce(closing_price, reference_price), trad_dt)::DOUBLE AS last_close
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_bulletin_index_report/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE record_type IN ($record_type)
    AND ticker <> 'TFIX'
    AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
  GROUP BY ticker
)
SELECT *, last_close / nullif(first_close, 0) - 1 AS period_return
FROM r
WHERE first_close > 0
ORDER BY period_return DESC
LIMIT 15

panels.title: Top losers (range)
panels.description: Bottom 15 period returns in the selected types; ignores the ticker filter.

targets.rawSql:
WITH r AS (
  SELECT
    ticker,
    any_value(record_type) AS type,
    any_value(description) AS description,
    arg_min(coalesce(closing_price, reference_price), trad_dt)::DOUBLE AS first_close,
    arg_max(coalesce(closing_price, reference_price), trad_dt)::DOUBLE AS last_close
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_bulletin_index_report/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE record_type IN ($record_type)
    AND ticker <> 'TFIX'
    AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
  GROUP BY ticker
)
SELECT *, last_close / nullif(first_close, 0) - 1 AS period_return
FROM r
WHERE first_close > 0
ORDER BY period_return ASC
LIMIT 15

panels.title: $ticker daily candles
panels.description: Daily open, high, low and close, one panel per selected ticker (indexes and IOPVs).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  trad_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time,
  opening_price::DOUBLE AS open,
  max_price::DOUBLE AS high,
  min_price::DOUBLE AS low,
  closing_price::DOUBLE AS close
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_bulletin_index_report/daily_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE ticker = $ticker
  AND record_type IN ($record_type)
  AND opening_price IS NOT NULL
  AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
ORDER BY time

panels.title: $ticker rising / stable / falling constituents
panels.description: Daily count of rising, stable and falling constituents, stacked so the top edge is the total, one panel per selected index.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  trad_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time,
  rising_shares AS "Rising",
  stable_shares AS "Stable",
  falling_shares AS "Falling"
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_bulletin_index_report/daily_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE ticker = $ticker
  AND record_type = 'index'
  AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
ORDER BY time
